sentences.en: Scientists are studying the solar system to find signs of life on other planets.
sentences.zh: 科学家正在研究太阳系，以寻找其他星球上存在生命的迹象。

sentences.en: Our solar system consists of eight planets orbiting around a star called the Sun.
sentences.zh: 我们的太阳系由围绕着一个叫做太阳的恒星运转的八大行星组成。

sentences.en: The movie was about astronauts exploring distant parts of our solar system.
sentences.zh: 这部电影讲述的是宇航员探索我们太阳系遥远部分的故事。
